eld.text: Cado, the High King's trusted knight, is impersonated by Oko, who disguises himself as Cado and wipes the twins' memory of their encounter.

Cado's griffin Hale is corrupted and killed by Garruk out of pity, and when Will removes the hedron from Garruk, the curse runs wild and Garruk rampages, injuring Cerise and killing Cado's corrupted griffin.
